triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER sp_passport_number_on_complete_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF onboarding_state, declared_accurate_at ON public.sp_passport_profiles FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.onboarding_state = 'completed'::text) AND (new.declared_accurate_at IS NOT NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION sp_passport_number_on_complete()
